verification.validation: Focused release gate for a frontend-only change (entry boot short path): docs and version checks, executor manifest check; TypeScript typecheck, all frontend units, build, npm pack of both packages and internal-content package scans (generic rules; no private denylist set). No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance; the CLI side was checked on a DSM 7.3 NAS with a short path to a stable page.

changes: Entry pages opened through their short path keep it in the address bar: bootEntryPage removes DSM's spl-short marker when it names shortPath, adds <base href> with the entry page's URL and replaces the address with the short path, the rest of the query and the hash; a DSM sign-in in the same tab keeps it. Package, CGI and WebAPI URLs stay anchored to the entry page; the short path wins over rewriteToAlias.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
